statement.description:
A soldier wants to buy $ w $ bananas in the shop. He has to pay $ k $ dollars for the first banana, $ 2k $ dollars for the second one and so on (in other words, he has to pay $ i·k $ dollars for the $ i $ -th banana).

He has $ n $ dollars. How many dollars does he have to borrow from his friend soldier to buy $ w $ bananas?
statement.formatI: The first line contains three positive integers $ k,n,w $ ( $ 1<=k,w<=1000 $ , $ 0<=n<=10^{9} $ ), the cost of the first banana, initial number of dollars the soldier has and number of bananas he wants.
statement.formatO: Output one integer — the amount of dollars that the soldier must borrow from his friend. If he doesn't have to borrow money, output $ 0 $ .

translation.description:
一名士兵想要在商店购买 $w$ 根香蕉。他需要为第一根香蕉支付 $k$ 美元，为第二根香蕉支付 $2k$ 美元，以此类推（也就是说，他需要为第 $i$ 根香蕉支付 $i·k$ 美元）。

他手上有 $n$ 美元。他想知道，为了买到 $w$ 根香蕉，他还需要向他的战友借多少钱？
translation.formatI: 第一行包含三个正整数 $k, n, w$（$1 \leq k, w \leq 1000$，$0 \leq n \leq 10^9$），分别表示第一根香蕉的价格、士兵手上原有的钱数和想要购买的香蕉数量。
translation.formatO: 输出一个整数，表示士兵需要向战友借的钱数。如果他的钱已经足够购买所需香蕉，则输出 $0$。
